text: Here is the trick. A ship coming home lines up two lights, one behind and above the other.
When the high light sits right on top of the low one, you are in the safe channel. Every sailor knows it.
But move the low light, and the safe line moves with it. Put it in the cliff, and the line runs straight onto the north rocks.
And if the high lamp goes dark for twelve seconds, a sailor has only one light left to trust.
Whoever did this was no wrecker. Only a keeper knows the lamp that well.
